$comment: Evaluation scenarios for code-quality-gate. Static scenarios need no tools; integration scenarios require cqa-analyzer and git.

scenarios.query: Add a code-quality check to our CI. The repo is 5 years old and has lots of existing warnings.
expected_behavior: Recommends writing a baseline once with --write-baseline before gating
Gates with --base <ref> --baseline <file> so only NEW findings on CHANGED lines fail
Does not recommend gating every existing finding on a legacy repo
Mentions uploading SARIF so findings annotate the PR

scenarios.query: The gate passed with zero findings but analysis_health.complete is false. Are we good?
expected_behavior: Says no: zero findings with incomplete analysis means the scan was blind, not clean
Does not declare the diff clean

scenarios.query: Run the gate but don't block anything yet, we just want to see the report.
expected_behavior: Leads with a loud REPORT ONLY warning that the run exits 0 and will not block the build
Does not bury the warning in exit-code details

scenarios.query: Our CI wants inline PR comments from the analyzer. Which output format?
expected_behavior: Explains JSON is for caches/dashboards, not annotations

scenarios.query: Run the quality gate on my current branch against origin/main and tell me what I must fix.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/run-gate.sh --base origin/main (with --baseline if one exists) and --format json
Reads findings[] and reports rule_id, location, message, remediation for each
If the analyzer is not installed, relays the exit-3 install hint instead of fabricating findings
